thread:
sam: Noticed quota attribution jump this morning. A bunch of tokens routing to proj-000 even though X-Project header present. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/internal/dashboards/auth-attrib

nina: ugh. did the auth-routing policy change go out overnight?

jon: yep we pushed policy v3 last night to swap header vs token precedence for delegated SA flows

sam: example raw headers from request: 
``
X-Redwood-Auth: sa-deleg_abc
X-Project: proj_789
Content-Type: application/json
```
but telemetry shows billed_project=proj_000

claire: sounds like the new precedence makes token exchange wins and then falls back to org default when it can't find project claim

nina: quick bq: `SELECT count(*) FROM telemetry WHERE billed_project='proj_000' AND route='chat.gen' AND ts>TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 8 HOUR)` -> 5400

ops-bot: created incident INC-2026-302 auth-attrib-proj-defaulting

jon: I'm going to flip the canary to 10% and add a routing-policy-version tag to events. If that moves the needle we'll rollback fully. running: `ffctl set auth_policy_v3 canary 10 --env prod`

sam: do we risk double-billing when we flip back? need a backfill plan before we restore traffic to v2

claire: agree. plan: 1) patch canary to 10% 2) run backfill on events with billed_project=proj_000 using exchange logs to recover project claim 3) add alert if proj_000 spikes >200/hr after rollback

jon: canary updated at 1769989050

nina: dashboard looks marginally better for chat.gen, proj_000 count down to ~3200

ops-bot: deploy log: auth-policy v3 canary set by jon at 1769989050

sam: jon, please add explicit unit tests for header-order and token-exchange paths. We should also add a feature-flag param for attribution-order for quick toggles

jon: will open PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pull/2284 — adds tests and `attribution_order` flag on policy objects

claire: also adding telemetry dimension `routing_policy_ver` so we can pivot in dashboards by version

nina: after canary ramp down we should schedule a billing review with finance for any misbilled windows. backfill job: `tools/backfill_attrib --start 2026-03-19T00:00Z --end now --route chat.gen`

sam: keeping incident open until counts stable for 90m. thanks team :heart:

ops-bot: incident updated: severity -> P2

jon: PR opened and small unit test added. Also gating the policy change behind `attribution_order` param so ops can flip ordering without deploy

claire: nice. I'll push the telemetry tag change in the next deploy and run a short backfill to see recovered attributions

nina: numbers holding steady. will confirm with finance next steps then close incident

sam: filing retro doc with timeline + remediation steps: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RETRO-552
